term: body and constitutive bodily nature (q.75 a.2)
definition: Model.IsBody classifies corporeal individuals in the source argument, not every entity or property a modern physicalism may admit. HasNaturally b n means that n belongs to b constitutively, as its determinate bodily nature; it does not mean b represents n as a cognitive object. BodilyDeterminacy requires a selected such nature for each body. The source interference conditional is a separate premise, never built into IsBody or HasNaturally.
